title: Expose the acceptance basis in core focus and inspect for linked completion
outcome: A core-only client can read the acceptance basis and complete a linked criterion after a label edit
acceptance: Core focus and inspect return acceptance_basis from the same snapshot as their criteria, and core complete accepts that value after a label edit while still refusing it after a genuine contract change.
A behavioral core read-to-completion regression covers both the label edit and changed-contract refusal without reading an agent show receipt.
